source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    rows = [tuple(row) for row in grid]
    template = Counter(rows).most_common(1)[0][0]
    base = Counter(template).most_common(1)[0][0]
    horizontal = [r for r, row in enumerate(rows) if row != template]
    vertical = [c for c, value in enumerate(template) if value != base]
    out = []
    for r in range(len(horizontal) - 1):
        line = []
        for c in range(len(vertical) - 1):
            a, b = grid[horizontal[r]][vertical[c]], grid[horizontal[r]][vertical[c + 1]]
            d, e = grid[horizontal[r + 1]][vertical[c]], grid[horizontal[r + 1]][vertical[c + 1]]
            line.append(a if a == b == d == e else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''

def make_case(height,width,base,vert,horiz,vertices,sepfill=None):

    for c in vert: template[c]= next(v for v in set(sum(vertices,[])) if v!=base) if False else template[c]

def transform(grid):

            d, e = grid[horizontal[r + 1]][vertical[c]], grid[horizontal[r + 1]][vertical[c + 1]]
            line.append(a if a == b == d == e else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
